answer: Proposal: max-flow admission. Maintain an atlas of endorsement edges: each verified member may endorse few newcomers, every edge carrying capacity one. An account's reward weight equals the max-flow it can draw from a seed set of verified members, so sybils multiplying behind one endorser inherit only its single capacity — a garden fed by one pipe waters a hundred beds no faster than one. No pearl of prestige is needed; flow, not fame, admits. Limit: assumes honest seeds, non-transferable edges, and audits that catch sold endorsements; bribery stays the open attack.
